title: d-frame
description: The algebraic dual of a bitopological space: a quadruple of two frames plus consistency and totality relations, generated as the algebraic chart on the same data a paired Priestley space presents spatially.

positive-frame.description: L_+, a complete lattice satisfying the infinite distributive law a /\ \/S = \/(a /\ s); the positive-datum side

negative-frame.description: L_-, a complete lattice with the infinite distributive law; the negative-datum side

con.description: consistency relation con <= L_+ x L_-: (a,b) in con asserts a and b are jointly consistent (joint extension non-empty); downward-closed and closed under directed joins on each side

tot.description: totality relation tot <= L_+ x L_-: (a,b) in tot asserts a and b together cover (joint extension is the whole space); upward-closed and closed under finite meets on each side

compatibility.description: the Jung-Moshier structural axioms tying con and tot together hold
